findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "observe" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_public_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_attack_approaches, find_continuations, assist_submission, new_in_scope · Private data: check_technology, find_continuations · Public sink: check_technology, find_attack_approaches, find_continuations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_attack_approaches, find_continuations, assist_submission, new_in_scope · Private data: check_technology, find_continuations · Public sink: check_technology, find_attack_approaches, find_continuations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
